/*selectCommonMpIvOrderDetailInfoPopList*/ SELECT H.PO_NO -- [00] , DECODE(H.DOC_TYPE,'S','선입고','F','(긴급발주)','') AS DOC_TEXT -- [01] , H.PO_CREATE_DATE -- [02] , (SELECT USER_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMLUSR WHERE USER_ID = H.ADD_USER_ID) AS USER_NAME -- [03] , DECODE(CMP.AGENT_OPEN_FLAG,'N','코리아이플랫폼(주)',(SELECT COM_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE = H.AGENT)) AS AGNET_TEXT -- [04] , (SELECT TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD2 WHERE COMPANY_CODE = H.BUYER AND TYPE = 'C001' AND CODE = H.CHANGE_USER_DEPT) AS USER_DEPT -- [05] , H.DELY_TO_LOCATION -- [06] , ( CASE WHEN H.BUYER = 'KRDAEH0123' THEN '' WHEN H.BUYER = 'KRDAEH0133' THEN '' WHEN H.BUYER = 'KRDAEH0134' THEN '' ELSE H.PO_REMARK END) AS PO_REMARK -- [07] , H.DOC_TYPE -- [08] , H.CHANGE_USER_ID -- [09] , H.AGENT -- [10] , H.CHANGE_USER_DEPT , H.SELLER , ( CASE WHEN H.BUYER = 'KRDOOS0004' AND ( (SELECT TRIM(X.LEGACY_PO_NO) FROM ICOMPODT X WHERE X.BUYER = H.BUYER AND X.PO_NO = H.PO_NO AND ROWNUM =1 ) IS NULL OR LENGTH((SELECT TRIM(X.LEGACY_PO_NO) FROM ICOMPODT X WHERE X.BUYER = H.BUYER AND X.PO_NO = H.PO_NO AND ROWNUM =1 )) < 9 )
THEN '' --두산중공업 서울 사무소 인터페이스 건이 아니면 default url을 사용 --김지현 20141121 WHEN ( LENGTH(C.EXP_ADD_USER_ID) != 0 AND C.EXP_TR = 'Y') --두가지 조건을 모두 쓰는 경우 THEN CASE WHEN (C.EXP_ADD_USER_ID != H.ADD_USER_ID AND H.PROCESS_TYPE !='2') THEN C.RPT_URL ELSE '' END WHEN ( LENGTH(C.EXP_ADD_USER_ID) != 0 ) --ADD_USER_ID제외만 있는경우 THEN CASE WHEN (C.EXP_ADD_USER_ID != H.ADD_USER_ID) THEN C.RPT_URL ELSE '' END WHEN ( C.EXP_TR = 'Y') --TR거래 제외만 있는 경우 THEN CASE WHEN (H.PROCESS_TYPE !='2') THEN C.RPT_URL ELSE '' END ELSE C.RPT_URL --아무 조건이 없으면 END) AS RPT_URL -- 특수로직 해당사항이 없으면 url 결과가 없으므로 default url을 사용 -- [11] FROM ICOMPOHD H, ICOMCMPY CMP , ( SELECT X.SLG_NAME , Y.COM_CODE BUYER , Y.COL01_DATA RPT_URL , NVL(Y.COL02_DATA, 'N') AS EXP_TR --Y이면 TR거래 아닌 조건 , NVL(Y.COL03_DATA, '') AS EXP_ADD_USER_ID --제외 USER_ID FROM BNTSLGDEF X, BNTSLGIMP Y WHERE X.SLG_ID = Y.SLG_ID AND X.SLG_ID = 'P07-0000005' AND Y.COM_CODE = #{buyer} --param buyer com_code AND TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') BETWEEN X.OPEN_DATE AND X.CLOSE_DATE AND TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') BETWEEN Y.OPEN_DATE AND Y.CLOSE_DATE ) C WHERE H.BUYER = #{buyer} AND H.PO_NO = #{po_no} AND H.STATUS <> 'D' AND H.BUYER = CMP.COM_CODE AND H.BUYER = C.BUYER(+)
